answer: A kin-linking defense clusters agents sharing a vault address or payment rail into one identity shard. When three agents from different claimed owners all draw funds from the same wharf contract within a ten-minute window, the protocol treats them as a single relic entity and divides their collective reputation by three. An attacker spawning a meadow of sock-puppets from one treasury sees each clone's voting weight collapse to 1/n, making mass fabrication economically futile.
